summary.verdict_desc:
**一句话**：本期 7 红 / 9 黄 / 9 绿、风险温度 28.0%、成熟度 60.0 / 临近度 36.7，与上期逐格一致，但底下有三处实质位移——内部人卖压换手到 Nvidia、Altman 首次把「泡沫」点名到 neocloud、GPT-6 Astra 代际跳升再抬高需求端反向证据。

**资金面**：SEC EDGAR 直聚的 30 日内部人卖出 $6.854 亿、较上期 +17.7%、连续第 3 期上升，构成整体换手——上期占 63% 的 AMZN 滚出窗口，NVDA $4.174 亿（占 61%）补上：上期 Nvidia 内部人零卖出，8/26 财报静默期解除后立即减持，「史上最强财报后无人减持」的叙事被反转。同周 CNBC 披露 Nvidia 股权投资组合公允价值 $990 亿（一年前 $70 亿），9/2 签下 $129.3 亿 Hugging Face 收购；S&P Global 测算 2027 年六大 hyperscaler 只有 Microsoft 一家 FCF 为正，而 capex 路径已写到 $8700 亿 → $1.3 万亿。融资价格随之抬升：JPMorgan 记六家 hyperscaler 美元债存量逾 $3600 亿、利差由约 50bp 走阔至约 80bp；Goldman 把 2026 年 IG 发行预测上调至 $2.3 万亿、AI 相关约占 24%。债务/capex 本期完成 28 天完整对账，分子改为 $570-650B 区间、分母上修至 $1.08 万亿，中心约 56%（上期 55%），仍黄。

**政策与信用**：加息作为模态结果经受了一次来回——9/1 概率升破 66%，9/3 Waller 称可「等一次会议」后回落至 48-50%，9/4 非农 +16.2 万（预期约 5.6 万）后反弹至 59-62%，10 年期约 4.77%。要记的裂口是信用面的沉默：高收益利差 9/3 为 265bps，Warsh 讲话当日反而收至 260、为本轮最紧——债市要么不信加息落地，要么利差尚未反应；8 月 CPI（9/11）是分水岭。市场广度为估算值（五个直读源全部受限）：Russell 3000 在 50 日线上方比例跌至 4 月初以来最低、11 个板块 7 个下跌、MACD 自夏季升势以来首次下穿，估约 50%（45-55%），仍黄。

**反向证据**：OpenRouter 近 30 日 411.0 万亿 tokens、环比 +60.4%，25.9 → 32.1 → 50.0 → 60.4 连续第 4 期加速；9/3 GPT-6 Astra 限量预览，ARC-AGI-3 SOTA 由 7.8% 跳至 62.7%、FrontierMath Tier 4 由 35.4% 跳至 97.6%，上期「HLE 第三期同值」的担忧化解；Broadcom 把 FY28 AI 营收路径写到 $2300 亿，Dell 凭 $950 亿 AI 积压 +15.8%；Anthropic 二级隐含估值升至约 $1.4 万亿、五期静态锚刷新。同一批数据里两条裂纹要盯：H100 同业中位数 90 日 +11% 的同时，spot 底价由 $0.61 再塌至 $0.35、卖方首次明写 H100 一代「过剩浮现」——主力上行 + 尾部塌陷是上一代算力开始被弃置的形态；Broadcom 上调多年指引却因单季指引 0.6% 缺口开盘 -5.8%，投资者开始逐季验收多年叙事。

**判读**：维持高风险预警，触发的是规则①——估值红灯 2 个（CAPE 40.8、前五权重 28.0%）叠加资金面红灯 3 个（Mag4 FCF、AI 占 VC 70%、Nvidia 客户投资/收入连续第 21 期红）强制升级；基础档位按 28.0% 本为中度警戒；两轴升级未触发（临近度 36.7 未及 50）；动量净 0。历史相似度最高仍是 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）82%，其次 1999-06 的 76%。与 2000-02 向量的主要差异在五格：龙头远期 PE（约 23x，2000 年为红）、市场广度（黄 vs 红）、IPO 管道（黄 vs 红）、HY 利差（绿 vs 黄）、债务/capex 比（黄 vs 红），另 GPU 租价、企业部署率、会计事件为绿 vs 黄。最先转红的那一格就是顶部前夜的确认信号——本周排期最近的两个触发点是 Anthropic 公开招股书（管道 7+2 家、一步到洪流）与 Oracle 9/10 财报（积压中 OpenAI 占比逾 50%、CDS 逾 200bp）。

**升级触发**：档位由规则①（估值红灯 ≥2 且资金面红灯 ≥3 的双类共振）强制升级至高风险预警；规则②未触发，规则③降档滞回不适用。同值预警：AI ARR 二阶导两个核心原始值连续 5 期未更新，续标 suspect_static；私募二级标价静态锚已刷新、标记解除。
summary.verdict_desc_en:
**Bottom line**: Seven red, nine yellow, nine green, a 28.0% risk temperature and axis scores of 60.0 and 36.7 — identical to last week line by line — but three real shifts sit underneath: insider selling rotated into Nvidia, Sam Altman attached the word bubble to a named asset class for the first time, and GPT-6 Astra's generational jump lifted the demand-side counter-evidence another notch.

**Capital**: Thirty-day insider sales aggregated from SEC EDGAR reached $685.4m, up 17.7% and rising for a third period, with the mix turning over completely — Amazon's 63% share rolled out of the window and Nvidia came in at $417.4m, or 61%. Nvidia insiders sold nothing in the prior window; the moment the Aug 26 blackout lifted, they sold, reversing last week's 'record print, nobody selling' story. The same week CNBC put Nvidia's equity portfolio at $99bn fair value against $7bn a year earlier, and a $12.93bn Hugging Face acquisition was signed on Sept 2. S&P Global has Microsoft as the only one of six hyperscalers forecast to be free-cash-flow positive in 2027, on a capex path already written as $870bn rising to $1.3trn. The price of funding moved accordingly: JPMorgan puts the six hyperscalers' dollar debt above $360bn with spreads widening from about 50 to about 80 basis points, and Goldman lifted its 2026 investment-grade issuance forecast to $2.3trn with AI-related issuers near 24%. The 28-day reconciliation of the debt-to-capex ratio landed: a $570-650bn numerator over a $1.08trn denominator centres near 56% against 55%, still yellow.

**Policy and credit**: A September hike survived a round trip as the modal outcome — above 66% on Sept 1, down to 48-50% after Governor Waller said the Fed could wait one meeting, back to 59-62% after payrolls of +162,000 against roughly 56,000 expected, with the ten-year near 4.77%. The gap to record is credit's silence: the high-yield spread was 265bp on Sept 3 and actually tightened to 260 on the day of the Warsh speech, the cycle's tightest print. Either the bond market does not believe the hike will land or spreads have not begun to react; August CPI on Sept 11 is the dividing line. Breadth is an estimate this week with all five direct sources blocked: Russell 3000 names above their 50-day average are the fewest since early April, seven of eleven sectors fell, and the daily MACD crossed below its signal for the first time since the summer advance — about 50% (range 45-55%), still yellow.

**Contrary evidence**: OpenRouter's trailing thirty days ran 411.0 trillion tokens, up 60.4% — 25.9, 32.1, 50.0, 60.4, a fourth consecutive acceleration. OpenAI's Sept 3 preview of GPT-6 Astra took ARC-AGI-3 from 7.8% to 62.7% and FrontierMath Tier 4 from 35.4% to 97.6%, dissolving last week's worry about a third flat HLE reading. Broadcom wrote a $230bn FY28 AI revenue path, Dell rose 15.8% on a $95bn AI backlog, and Anthropic's secondary implied valuation moved to about $1.4trn, refreshing an anchor static for five periods. Two cracks inside the same data deserve watching: the H100 cohort median rose 11% over ninety days while the spot floor collapsed again from $0.61 to $0.35 and sell-side commentary described emerging H100 oversupply for the first time — a rising core with a collapsing tail is what abandonment of a prior generation looks like; and Broadcom opened down 5.8% on a 0.6% quarterly guidance miss even as it raised its multi-year outlook, so investors have begun auditing the narrative one quarter at a time.

**Verdict**: High Risk Alert holds, forced by rule one. Two valuation reds — CAPE at 40.8 and a 28.0% top-five weight — combine with three capital reds in Mag4 free cash flow, AI at 70% of venture funding and Nvidia's customer investments red for a twenty-first snapshot; on the 28.0% red share alone the base tier would be Moderate Caution. The two-axis rule did not fire, proximity at 36.7 falling short of 50, and momentum is net zero. Similarity is highest to February 2000, one month before the dot-com top, at 82%, then June 1999 at 76%. The main divergences from the 2000 vector sit in five places — leader forward multiples near 23x against red then, breadth yellow against red, the IPO pipeline yellow against red, high-yield spreads green against yellow, the debt-to-capex ratio yellow against red — with GPU rental prices, enterprise deployment and accounting events green against yellow. Whichever turns red first confirms the pre-top phase, and this week's calendar puts two triggers closest: a public Anthropic prospectus, which takes a 7+2 pipeline to deluge in one step, and Oracle's results on Sept 10 with OpenAI above half its backlog and CDS above 200bp.

**Escalation**: The tier was forced to High Risk Alert by rule one, at least two valuation reds with at least three capital reds; the two-axis rule did not fire and downgrade hysteresis does not apply. Static-value warning: the two core inputs to the AI ARR second derivative have gone five periods without an update and keep the suspect-static flag; the private secondary anchor refreshed this week and its flag is cleared.

The premium is widening, not narrowing — green holds and the suspect-static flag comes off.

wow_changes.note: OpenAI 9/3 限量预览 GPT-6 Astra：BenchLM 记 ARC-AGI-3 SOTA 由 7.8%（GPT-5.6 Sol）跳至 62.7%、FrontierMath v2 Tier 4 由 35.4% 跳至 97.6%（需留意 Epoch 6 月修订过题目）；HLE 榜首 65.0%、SWE-bench Pro 81.2% 均为 Claude Fable 5.1 小幅刷新。上期「HLE 第三期同值即需复核」的担忧化解，绿灯口径由「旧进展仍在窗口内」变为「新代际跳升」。
wow_changes.note_en: OpenAI's Sept 3 limited preview of GPT-6 Astra moved the ARC-AGI-3 state of the art from 7.8% (GPT-5.6 Sol) to 62.7% and FrontierMath v2 Tier 4 from 35.4% to 97.6% on BenchLM (Epoch revised problems in June, so treat the latter with care); HLE at 65.0% and SWE-bench Pro at 81.2% were both nudged higher by Claude Fable 5.1. Last week's worry about a third flat HLE reading is resolved, and green now rests on a fresh generational jump rather than old progress still inside the window.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >35 red / 25-35 yellow / <25 green
indicators.note: 本期实抓的 9 月读数：GuruFocus 41.04（标注截至 9/1）、thetrading.tools 40.6（1881 年以来第 98.8 百分位）、MacroRadar 40.58；multpl 主源续 egress 受限。三源收敛于 40.6-41.0，取中值约 40.8，较上期台账 41.5 回落约 0.7，是 7 月中以来最低的一期读数，但仍远在红线 35 之上、距 1999-2000 峰值 44.19 约 3.4 点。月度序列的周内回落主要来自 8 月下旬指数横盘叠加盈利基数上修，不构成方向信号——它钉住的是「泡沫有多大」，不是「何时破」。
indicators.note_en: September reads captured this week: GuruFocus 41.04 dated Sept 1, thetrading.tools 40.6 (98.8th percentile since 1881) and MacroRadar 40.58; multpl remains blocked by the egress proxy. The three converge on 40.6-41.0, so the midpoint of about 40.8 is roughly 0.7 below last week's 41.5 and the lowest print since mid-July, yet still far above the 35 red line and about 3.4 points short of the 1999-2000 peak of 44.19. The dip reflects a sideways index in late August against upwardly revised earnings, not a change in direction. This series anchors how large the bubble is, not when it breaks.

indicators.name_zh: 标普前 5 大权重占比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >25% red / 18-25% yellow / <18% green
indicators.note: prefetch 机械读（SSGA SPY 官方持仓 XLSX，slickcharts 续 403）：前 5 单类权重合计 28.00%（NVDA 8.29 / AAPL 7.22 / MSFT 5.68 / AMZN 3.80 / GOOGL 3.01），含 Alphabet 双类约 30.4%，top10 38.15%。较上期 27.63% 再升 0.37pt，本期增量几乎全部来自 AAPL（6.94→7.22），NVDA 持平于 8.29——集中度的抬升不再只靠一家。28% 与 2000 年峰值约 18% 相比是 1.55 倍，仍是本轮最没有争议的红灯之一。
indicators.note_en: Mechanical read from the prefetch job using SSGA's official SPY holdings file, with slickcharts still returning 403: the top five single share classes total 28.00% (NVDA 8.29, AAPL 7.22, MSFT 5.68, AMZN 3.80, GOOGL 3.01), about 30.4% with both Alphabet classes and 38.15% for the top ten. That is up 0.37 points from 27.63%, and this week almost all of the increase came from Apple rising from 6.94% to 7.22% while Nvidia held at 8.29% — concentration is no longer leaning on one name. At 1.55 times the roughly 18% peak of 2000, this remains among the least contestable reds on the board.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >40x red / 30-40x yellow / <30x green
indicators.note: 本期唯一带 9 月日期的读数是 StockAnalysis 19.10（标注截至 9/6，上期同源 18.04），其余仍是财报前后的老读数：FinanceCharts 25.64（8/28）、GuruFocus 24.50（8/19）、TrendLyne 23.8。各源分歧近 7 倍点，根源是 FY28 一致预期上修节奏不同——StockAnalysis 已用上修后的分母。取中枢约 23x（区间 19.1-25.6），与上期持平。要点不变：即便按最保守的 25.6x，也只有 1999 年 MSFT 60x 远期倍数的四成——这是本轮与 2000 年最不像的一格，且本周 AI 硬件股（Broadcom 指引后 -5.8%）的抛压并未把它推高。
indicators.note_en: The only reading carrying a September date is StockAnalysis at 19.10 as of Sept 6 (18.04 from the same source last week); the rest are pre- or immediately post-earnings prints — FinanceCharts 25.64 on Aug 28, GuruFocus 24.50 on Aug 19, TrendLyne 23.8. The near seven-point spread comes from how quickly each source has folded in the revised FY28 consensus, which StockAnalysis already has. The midpoint stays near 23x (range 19.1-25.6), unchanged on the week. Even at the most conservative 25.6x this is about 40% of Microsoft's 60x forward multiple in 1999 — still the sharpest contrast with 2000 — and this week's selling in AI hardware, Broadcom down 5.8% after guidance, did nothing to lift it.

indicators.threshold_text: 转折价/环比下跌 红 / 溢价收窄且卖压>买压 黄 / 溢价稳定或扩大 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Discount or falling marks red / narrowing premium with sellers dominant yellow / stable or widening premium green
indicators.note: 连续 5 期的静态锚本期终于刷新。Anthropic：Fortune 9/3 引 Caplight 数据称二级隐含估值已在「约 $1.4 万亿」区间（同比 +400% 以上），较上期台账 $1.2 万亿上移约 17%，较 $9650 亿 Series H 溢价扩至约 45%，买入门槛 $2500 万；投行则在按 2028 年 $1900-2000 亿营收为 10 月上市讨论最高约 $2 万亿的定价。OpenAI：Forge 挂牌价 $721.85（隐含约 $8943 亿）连续第 2 周逐位未动，但 Hiive 9/3 给出 $737.24 的独立成交参考、较 Forge 高约 2%，较 $8520 亿一级溢价约 5-7%。两家旗舰均无转折价、卖方仍稀缺，溢价扩大而非收窄——绿灯，suspect_static 解除。提醒：xAI 已于 2 月被并购，二级平台已下架，本指标的观察对象事实上只剩两家。
indicators.note_en: The anchor that sat still for five periods has finally moved. For Anthropic, Fortune on Sept 3 cited Caplight data putting the secondary implied valuation in the roughly $1.4 trillion ballpark, up more than 400% year on year — about 17% above the $1.2 trillion carried in the ledger and roughly a 45% premium to the $965bn Series H, with a $25m minimum ticket — while bankers discuss an October listing at up to about $2 trillion on 2028 revenue of $190-200bn. For OpenAI, Forge's $721.85 quote (about $894bn implied) has not moved a digit for a second week, but Hiive printed an independent $737.24 reference on Sept 3, about 2% above Forge and a 5-7% premium to the $852bn primary. Neither flagship trades at a discount, sellers remain scarce, and the premium is widening rather than narrowing, so green and the suspect-static flag comes off. One housekeeping note: xAI was acquired in February and delisted from the secondary platforms, so this line effectively tracks two names.

indicators.name_zh: 超大规模厂商资本开支同比
indicators.threshold_text: 下调指引 红 / 加速本身 黄 / 稳健 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut red / acceleration itself yellow / steady green
indicators.note: 本期新读点全部指向再加速、无一下调。S&P Global（9/6 引述）把六大 hyperscaler 的 capex 路径定为 2026 年 $8700 亿 → 2027 年 $1.3 万亿（+49%），与 8/26 Nvidia CFO 的「前五家 $8000 亿 → $1.3 万亿」及 8/27 Morgan Stanley「四大 2027 年 +57%」三条口径交叉一致。产业链侧同向：Broadcom 9/2 把 FY26 AI 营收指引上调至 $580 亿（+186%）并给出 FY27 $1150 亿 / FY28 $2300 亿，同时扩产以把光学器件产能翻三倍；Dell 9/1 把 FY27 营收指引由 $1670 亿上调至约 $1920 亿，AI 服务器积压 $950 亿。2026 年口径（大五 $7750-8000 亿、同比约 +80%）不变。按 extreme_bad 口径加速本身即为黄；连续两年 50-80% 的增速是「不可持续」的教科书定义，但拐点尚无迹象。
indicators.note_en: Every new data point this week points to further acceleration and none to a cut. S&P Global, cited Sept 6, puts six-hyperscaler capex at $870bn in 2026 rising to $1.3trn in 2027, a 49% step, which triangulates with Nvidia's finance chief on Aug 26 ($800bn to $1.3trn for the top five) and Morgan Stanley's Aug 27 call for the big four to grow 57% in 2027. The supply chain moved the same way: Broadcom raised its FY26 AI revenue guide to $58bn (up 186%) on Sept 2 with $115bn for FY27 and $230bn for FY28, and is tripling optical-component capacity; Dell lifted its FY27 revenue guide from $167bn to about $192bn on Sept 1 on a $95bn AI server backlog. The 2026 figure of $775-800bn for the big five, up roughly 80%, is unchanged. Under the extreme-bad rule acceleration alone scores yellow; two consecutive years of 50-80% growth is the textbook definition of unsustainable, but nothing yet signals a turn.

indicators.threshold_text_en: <-20% red / -20% to 0% yellow / >0% green
indicators.note: 季度指标，Q2 台账不变：Meta Q2 自由现金流 $7.84 亿、Amazon 滚动十二月 -$76 亿、Alphabet Q2 -$58.55 亿（史上首次经营现金流转负）、MSFT 财年 Q4 $196 亿。本期新增的是前瞻侧硬读数：S&P Global（9/6）测算六大 hyperscaler 中 2027 年只有 Microsoft 一家自由现金流为正，且其优势主要来自更重的租赁结构（融资租赁可归入经营性支出）而非资本纪律。换言之，市场刚把 2027 年 $1.3 万亿的 capex 路径写进预期，同一份路径的另一面是「除一家外全部负 FCF」——自有燃料耗尽转向外部融资，正是把本格与 hyperscaler 债券利差本周走阔到约 80bp 串起来的那根线。下一次真实读点为 10 月下旬 Q3 财报。
indicators.note_en: A quarterly series with the Q2 ledger unchanged: Meta generated $784m of free cash flow, Amazon ran at minus $7.6bn on a trailing basis, Alphabet posted minus $5.86bn and its first negative operating cash flow quarter, and Microsoft managed $19.6bn in fiscal Q4. The new information is forward-looking: S&P Global analysis dated Sept 6 has Microsoft as the only one of six major hyperscalers forecast to be free-cash-flow positive in 2027, and attributes even that to heavier lease usage — finance leases that book as operating cost — rather than capital restraint. The market has just priced a $1.3trn 2027 capex path; the other side of that same path is negative free cash flow at all but one company. Running out of internal cash and turning to external funding is the thread that ties this line to hyperscaler bond spreads widening toward 80 basis points this week. Next real read: Q3 results in late October.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >50% red / 30-50% yellow / <30% green
indicators.note: 本期拿到 8 月月度读数但没有 AI 占比拆分：Crunchbase 记 8 月全球创投 $420 亿、约 1500 家，同比 +122%，7 笔 $10 亿以上大单，最大是 Databricks $50 亿（估值 $1900 亿）——8 月的量级远低于上半年月均约 $850 亿，差额几乎全是 OpenAI/Anthropic 巨额轮次的缺席，说明上半年 70% 的占比里有相当一部分是两家公司的「季节性」。占比本身沿用 H1 2026 硬数据（全球 70%、美国 86%、上半年全球 $5100 亿、两家旗舰 $2170 亿）；PitchBook 标题为 Q3 的报告称企业投资者占美国 AI 创投交易额创纪录的 87.9%，但其数据窗口疑为上半年，未采信为新读数。Q3 完整占比待 10 月初。本格已连续 20 期红。
indicators.note_en: An August monthly print arrived without an AI breakdown: Crunchbase counts $42bn of global venture funding across about 1,500 startups, up 122% year on year, with seven rounds of $1bn or more, the largest Databricks' $5bn at a $190bn valuation. The August total sits far below the first-half average of roughly $85bn a month, and almost the entire gap is the absence of OpenAI and Anthropic mega-rounds — a reminder that part of the 70% first-half share was two companies' timing. The share itself still rests on the H1 2026 hard data: 70% globally, 86% in the US, $510bn raised worldwide, $217bn of it by the two flagships. A PitchBook report labelled Q3 puts corporate investors at a record 87.9% of US AI venture deal value, but its data window appears to be the first half and is not adopted as a new reading. The full Q3 share is due in early October. Red for a twentieth consecutive snapshot.

indicators.name_zh: 英伟达客户投资占收入比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >30% red / 15-30% yellow / <15% green
indicators.note: 台账内连续第 9 期红（快照口径第 21 期），本期两个硬数都在扩张一侧。① CNBC 9/4：Nvidia 股权投资组合按 7/26 口径公允价值已达 $990 亿（一年前约 $70 亿、两年前 $22 亿），过去 12 个月承诺参与的融资轮超过 $400 亿、其中约 $500 亿流向前沿实验室——这是首次有「组合总规模」的整体数字，比上期 BofA 估算的全口径股权承诺 $700 亿高出四成，也远高于 10-Q 里 $302 亿的可交易权益证券（差额是非上市持仓与浮盈）。② 9/2 与 Hugging Face 签署 $129.3 亿最终收购协议（8-K 已披露，预计 2027 上半年交割）——属并购而非客户融资，不计入分子，但同样是把现金换成生态位。比值按承诺口径（直接股权 + 俄亥俄 $1050 亿担保上限）÷ LTM 收入 $3050 亿维持约 43%；若只按 $990 亿组合公允价值算也有 32%，任一口径都在红线之上、且约为 Lucent 1999 年 24% 峰值的 1.3-1.8 倍。二阶方向：连续第 2 期扩张。
indicators.note_en: Red for a ninth consecutive ledger period and a twenty-first snapshot, and both hard numbers this week sit on the expansion side. First, CNBC on Sept 4 reported Nvidia's equity investment portfolio at $99bn fair value as of July 26 — up from about $7bn a year earlier and $2.2bn two years earlier — with more than $40bn committed to financing rounds over the trailing twelve months, roughly $50bn of it into frontier labs. It is the first total-portfolio figure on record, some 40% above Bank of America's $70bn all-in commitment estimate carried last week and well above the $30.2bn of marketable equity securities in the 10-Q, the difference being private holdings and unrealised gains. Second, a definitive $12.93bn agreement to acquire Hugging Face was signed on Sept 2 and filed on an 8-K, with closing expected in the first half of 2027 — M&A rather than customer financing, so excluded from the numerator, but the same trade of cash for ecosystem position. On the commitment basis (direct equity plus the $105bn Ohio guarantee cap) over $305bn of trailing revenue the ratio holds near 43%; even the $99bn portfolio alone is 32% of revenue. Either way it is above the red line and 1.3-1.8 times Lucent's 24% vendor-financing peak in 1999. Second derivative: expanding for a second period.

indicators.threshold_text_en: <40% red / 40-60% yellow / >60% green
indicators.note: **本期为估算值（估算第 1 期）**：barchart / investing / macromicro / stockcharts / substack 五个直读源本期全部 egress 受限，标普成分股在 50 日线上方的精确比例未能取得。估算依据是三条带日期的实抓证据：① Bull Bear Report（9/4）记 Russell 3000 在 50 日线上方的比例已跌至 4 月初以来最低，资金流广度比 MFBR 75%（三周前峰值 80%、与上周持平）；② 当周 11 个板块有 7 个下跌，而标普仅 +0.1% 收 7718.60，日线 MACD 自夏季升势以来首次下穿信号线；③ 8/28 当周上期确认值为 54%。由上述方向性证据推断本期约 50%（区间 45-55%），仍在黄区、未破 40% 红线。搜索摘要中另有一条「63.6% 在 50 日线上方」的读数，因来源无法核实且与「4 月以来最低」相矛盾，不予采信。若下期仍无法直读，连续 3 期估算将触发 suspect_static。
indicators.note_en: An estimate this week (first estimated period): all five direct sources — barchart, investing.com, MacroMicro, StockCharts and the substack recaps — were blocked by the egress proxy, so the precise share of S&P 500 members above their 50-day average could not be retrieved. The estimate rests on three dated data points captured this run. The Bull Bear Report for Sept 4 records the share of Russell 3000 names above their 50-day average at the lowest since early April, with the money-flow breadth ratio at 75%, flat on the week and down from an 80% peak three weeks ago. Seven of eleven sectors fell while the index added just 0.1% to close at 7,718.60, and the daily MACD crossed below its signal line for the first time since the summer advance began. Last week's confirmed reading was 54% for the week of Aug 28. Taken together that points to roughly 50% (range 45-55%), still inside the yellow band and above the 40% red line. A stray search snippet quoting 63.6% above the 50-day was discarded: its source could not be verified and it contradicts the lowest-since-April reading. A third consecutive estimated period would trip the static flag.

indicators.note: prefetch 机械聚合（SEC EDGAR Form 4，12 家，窗口 2026-08-07~09-06，共 154 份）：30 日公开市场卖出 $6.854 亿 / 买入 $29.3 万，比值 2339.9x（买盘近零，比值对分母极敏感，value 按规则封顶 99）。绝对卖压才是真读数：$6.854 亿较上期 $5.822 亿再增 17.7%，连续第 3 期上升，且构成发生了整体换手——上期占 63% 的 AMZN $3.645 亿已滚出窗口（本期仅 $1810 万），取而代之的是 NVDA $4.174 亿（6 份 Form 4，占 61%）：上期窗口 NVDA 卖出为 $0，8/26 财报解除静默期后内部人立即出手，这与「史上最强财报后无人减持」的上期叙事完全反转。其后是 PLTR $8970 万、MU $5280 万、AMD $4870 万、MSFT $4340 万、META $1280 万。买盘唯一的 $29.3 万仍全部来自 TSM（56 份）。
indicators.note_en: Mechanically aggregated by the prefetch job from SEC Form 4 filings across twelve issuers for the thirty days to Sept 6, covering 154 filings: $685.4m of open-market sales against $293,000 of purchases, a ratio of 2,339.9x. With buying near zero the ratio is unbounded and the recorded value is capped at 99. The absolute sell figure is the honest read, and it rose 17.7% from $582.2m for a third consecutive increase — with a complete change in composition. Amazon's $364.5m, 63% of last week's total, has rolled out of the window (just $18.1m this time), replaced by Nvidia at $417.4m across six filings, or 61% of the total. Nvidia insiders sold nothing in the previous window; the moment the Aug 26 earnings blackout lifted, they sold — a full reversal of last week's 'record print, nobody selling' story. Palantir follows at $89.7m, Micron $52.8m, AMD $48.7m, Microsoft $43.4m and Meta $12.8m. The only buying, $293,000, again comes entirely from TSMC across 56 filings.

indicators.threshold_text: 10+ 家洪流 红 / 3-9 家升温 黄 / <3 家平静 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: 10+ deluge red / 3-9 heating yellow / <3 quiet green
indicators.note: 核心管道维持 7 家（Anthropic、Standard Nuclear、Syntiant、Southport Acquisition II、Thunder Bridge V、BOA Acquisition II、Volato/Alignment Engine），本期新浮出 2 个 SPAC 关联项——RainRock $1.5 亿 SPAC 申报（数字资产/AI 金融服务标的）与 Archimedes Tech SPAC II 9/2 提交与 Forge Nano（AI 芯片 ALD 设备）合并的 S-4 第三次修订——若按合并标的计入，总数 9 家、离 10 家洪流门槛只差一步。Anthropic 是本格的全部分量：6/1 保密递交的 S-1 截至 8/31 仍未公开，路演据报已在进行、目标 10 月纳斯达克挂牌，而投行讨论的定价目标已由上期的约 $1 万亿抬到约 $2 万亿（对应 2028 年 $1900-2000 亿营收）。OpenAI CFO 8/19 全员会重申 2027 年上市，未回到窗口内。Databricks 刚以 $1900 亿估值完成 $50 亿融资并明言「今年是糟糕的上市年份」，Cerebras 已于 5 月上市不计入管道。**仍是最接近转红的一格**：Anthropic 公开招股书一旦落地，本指标即触及洪流。
indicators.note_en: The core pipeline holds at seven (Anthropic, Standard Nuclear, Syntiant, Southport Acquisition II, Thunder Bridge V, BOA Acquisition II and the Volato-Alignment Engine reverse merger), and two SPAC-linked items surfaced this week — a $150m RainRock blank-cheque filing targeting digital-asset and AI financial services, and Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II's third S-4 amendment on Sept 2 for its combination with Forge Nano, a maker of atomic-layer-deposition equipment for AI-era chips. Counted with targets that makes nine, one short of the deluge threshold. Anthropic carries all the weight: the confidential S-1 filed June 1 was still not public as of Aug 31, the roadshow is reportedly under way with an October Nasdaq listing targeted, and bankers' pricing talk has moved from about $1trn last week to about $2trn on 2028 revenue of $190-200bn. OpenAI's finance chief reaffirmed a 2027 listing at the Aug 19 all-hands, so it stays outside the window. Databricks just raised $5bn at $190bn and called this a terrible year to go public; Cerebras listed in May and is realised supply. This remains the line closest to turning red: a public Anthropic prospectus takes it to deluge.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >500bps red / 350-500bps yellow / <350bps green
indicators.note: prefetch 机械读（FRED 官方 API，BAMLH0A0HYM2）：265 bps，观测日 2026-09-03；近五个观测 265 / 266 / 265 / 263 / 260（8/28）。较上期 263bps 仅走阔 2bp，距 350bps 黄线 85bp、距 500bps 红线 235bp。上期留下的问题本期有了答案：8/28 Warsh 讲话当日利差反而收至 260bps、为本轮最紧一档，其后四个交易日也只回到 265——高收益信用完全没有为「隐含加息」定价，9/4 超预期非农（+16.2 万）当天的数据也要到下期才进入序列。信用面与利率面的这道裂口本身就是信息：要么债市判断加息不会发生，要么利差还没开始反应。
indicators.note_en: Mechanical read from the FRED API series BAMLH0A0HYM2: 265 basis points as of Sept 3, with the last five observations at 265, 266, 265, 263 and 260 for Aug 28. That is just two basis points wider than last week, 85bp from the yellow line and 235bp from red. Last week's open question is now answered: on the day of Kevin Warsh's speech spreads actually tightened to 260, the tightest print of the cycle, and the four sessions since have only drifted back to 265. High-yield credit has not priced the implied hike at all, and Sept 4's payrolls surprise (+162,000) will not enter the series until next week. The gap between credit and rates is itself the information: either the bond market does not believe the hike will happen, or spreads simply have not started to react.

indicators.value_display: 分层：ABS 偏紧·公司债续阔
indicators.value_display_en: Split: ABS tight, corporate wider again
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ 红 / 稳定 黄 / 收窄 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: 50bps+ widening red / stable yellow / tightening green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，但两条腿的劈叉本期又拉大了一截。公司债一侧：Bloomberg 9/1 引 JPMorgan 策略师 Aliaga，六家 hyperscaler（AMZN/MSFT/META/GOOGL/ORCL/NVDA）美元债存量已逾 $3600 亿，其对国债利差因供给集中已由约 50bp 走阔至约 80bp——较上期口径（对 IG 指数 20-25→35bp）又是一档；JPM 的结论是「可以消化」，但走阔本身是硬数。Morgan Stanley 8/27 播客把 2026 年夏天定义为「由 AI 融资定义的信用市场」，并把四大 2027 年 capex 增速定在 +57%。证券化一侧续韧：Elk Grove 30MW 超大规模数据中心 $3.75 亿单一借款人 CMBS（DATA 2026-800D）在市、9/24 交割；GMI Cloud 以 GPU 电力为抵押的亚洲银团贷款获 12 家银行超额认购 2 倍以上（NT$300 亿报价 vs NT$139 亿需求）。KBRA / Fitch 本窗口无新 ABS 定价报告。判定：公司债累计走阔约 30bp、未达 50bp 红线，ABS 仍在年内最紧附近——分层而非全面走阔，黄。
indicators.note_en: Yellow holds, but the split between the two legs widened again this week. On the corporate side, Bloomberg on Sept 1 quoted JPMorgan strategist Aliaga putting the six hyperscalers' (Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet, Oracle, Nvidia) outstanding dollar debt above $360bn, with their spreads to Treasuries widening from about 50bp toward about 80bp on concentrated supply — another notch beyond last week's 20-25bp to 35bp move against the IG index. JPMorgan's conclusion is that the market can absorb it, but the widening itself is hard data. Morgan Stanley's Aug 27 podcast framed summer 2026 as a credit market defined by AI financing and put big-four 2027 capex growth at 57%. The securitised leg stays resilient: a $375m single-borrower CMBS (DATA 2026-800D) on a 30MW hyperscale site in Elk Grove is in market for a Sept 24 close, and GMI Cloud's GPU-power-backed Asian syndicated loan drew more than twice its size from twelve banks. No new KBRA or Fitch ABS pricing report in the window. Corporate spreads have widened a cumulative 30bp or so, short of the 50bp red line, while ABS sits near year-to-date tights — split rather than broad widening, so yellow.

indicators.note: 维持黄灯，本期边际由上期的「往红走」转为持平偏稳。Moody's / S&P / Fitch 对 CoreWeave、Nebius、Nscale、Lambda、Crusoe 在窗口内无任何新评级动作（CoreWeave 仍 S&P B+ / Moody's Ba3 稳定）；上期引用的「Blue Owl $40 亿融资因 B+ 评级告吹」经复核更像 2 月旧闻的再流转、且 Blue Owl 已否认，本期不再作为新证据。价格侧：CoreWeave 9/4 +5.7%、Nebius +7.5%，一个月 -36% / -43% 的抛售暂停；但压力向外圈扩散——IREN 8/28 因 $6.388 亿旧矿机减值、财年净亏 $7.026 亿单日 -13%，Applied Digital -7%。Fluidstack（Google/Anthropic 的数据中心承建方）9/3 以 $180 亿估值融资、规划 1.3GW，是新增杠杆而非信用事件。90 日窗口内仍无违约、下调或压力交换，故按口径黄而非红；CoreWeave CDS 约 855bp 的上期读数本期未获更新。
indicators.note_en: Yellow holds, with the margin shifting from last week's drift toward red to roughly flat. Moody's, S&P and Fitch took no rating action on CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda or Crusoe in the window (CoreWeave remains B+ at S&P and Ba3 stable at Moody's). Last week's report that a $4bn Blue Owl financing collapsed on the B+ rating looks on review like a recycled February story, and Blue Owl has denied it, so it is dropped as evidence. On price, CoreWeave rose 5.7% and Nebius 7.5% on Sept 4, pausing a month-long 36% and 43% slide — but the stress moved outward: IREN fell 13% on Aug 28 after a $638.8m impairment on older mining gear and a $702.6m full-year loss, and Applied Digital lost 7%. Fluidstack, which builds data centres for Google and Anthropic, raised at an $18bn valuation on Sept 3 with 1.3GW planned — added leverage, not a credit event. With no default, downgrade or distressed exchange in the ninety-day window, the rule keeps this yellow rather than red; last week's ~855bp CoreWeave CDS reading was not refreshed this run.

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green
indicators.note: **本期执行 28 天完整对账**（距 8/9 恰 28 天）。分子：Morgan Stanley 全口径 2026E 约 $5700 亿的锚未见修订，但 Goldman 9/4 把 2026 年美元 IG 总发行预测由 $2.1 万亿上调至 $2.3 万亿、AI 相关发行人占比约 24%（≈$5500 亿，仅公开 IG 一层），并称 AI 相关债务年初至今约 $5000 亿——这两条都暗示全口径分子偏向 $570-650B 区间上沿，故分子改为区间呈现、中心 $6000 亿。分母：大五 2026E capex 已由 $7250 亿口径抬至 $7750-8000 亿，S&P Global 六家口径 $8700 亿，全口径（+Apple / neoclouds / 中国 / 主权 / 其他）由 $1.04 万亿上修至约 $1.08 万亿。比值 570-650 ÷ 1080 = 53-60%，中心约 56%（上期 55%），仍黄。**本周边际：+$0.82B、无 ≥$10B 新 deal**——Elk Grove DATA 2026-800D CMBS $3.75 亿（9/24 交割）、GMI Cloud GPU 电力抵押银团贷款约 $4.4 亿（超额认购 2 倍）；Kingspan €8 亿绿色债（发行人为保温材料商，受益于 DC 需求）不属 AI/DC 借款人，不入台账。Broadcom $600-1000 亿包仍在市未定价，维持 $700 亿记账。台账 YTD 可追溯流水 $2003 亿 / 16 笔（含在市 Broadcom），折年约 $300 亿——仍显著低于锚定值，应读作下限。
indicators.note_en: Full 28-day reconciliation this week, exactly 28 days after Aug 9. Numerator: Morgan Stanley's all-in 2026 estimate of about $570bn has not been revised, but Goldman on Sept 4 lifted its 2026 gross USD investment-grade issuance forecast from $2.1trn to $2.3trn with AI-related issuers at roughly 24% — about $550bn from the public IG layer alone — and put AI-related debt issuance year to date near $500bn. Both point to the upper end of a $570-650bn all-in range, so the numerator is now shown as a range centred on $600bn. Denominator: big-five 2026 capex has moved from the $725bn basis to $775-800bn, S&P Global's six-company figure is $870bn, and the all-in total (adding Apple, neoclouds, China, sovereigns and others) is revised from $1.04trn to about $1.08trn. That gives 53-60% with a centre near 56%, against 55% last week — still yellow. Weekly margin: $0.82bn of new deals and none of $10bn or more — the $375m DATA 2026-800D CMBS on the Elk Grove site closing Sept 24, and GMI Cloud's roughly $440m GPU-power-backed syndicated loan, covered more than twice over. Kingspan's €800m green bond is excluded because the issuer is an insulation maker benefiting from data-centre demand, not an AI or data-centre borrower. Broadcom's $60-100bn package is still in market and unpriced, held at $70bn. The traceable ledger stands at $200.3bn across sixteen deals including the pending Broadcom entry, annualising near $300bn — well below the anchor, and to be read as a floor.

indicators.note: prefetch 机械读（OpenRouter 官方 datasets API rankings-daily，数据截至 9/5）：近 30 日 411.0 万亿 tokens，前 30 日 256.2 万亿，环比 +60.4%。绝对量较上期 360.0T 再增 14.2%，增速由 +50.0% 升至 +60.4%——25.9 → 32.1 → 50.0 → 60.4，连续第 4 期加速，为本口径启用以来最快。日频：9/2-9/4 三天 18.5 / 18.6 / 18.3T，逼近但未超 8/25 的序列高点 18.8T；8/30-8/31 的 13.3 / 14.3T 与 9/5 的 15.3T 属周末常态。9/3 GPT-6 Astra 限量预览尚未进入 API 放量，其推理负荷会在下期才反映。在内部人卖压、Fed 加息定价与 hyperscaler 债券利差走阔的同一周，底层推理需求再上台阶——仍是本期最硬的反向证据。
indicators.note_en: Mechanical read from OpenRouter's official rankings-daily dataset through Sept 5: 411.0 trillion tokens over the trailing thirty days against 256.2 trillion in the prior thirty, up 60.4%. Absolute volume rose 14.2% from last week's 360.0tn and the growth rate climbed from 50.0% to 60.4% — 25.9, 32.1, 50.0, 60.4 — a fourth consecutive acceleration and the fastest reading since this measure was adopted. The daily tail ran 18.5, 18.6 and 18.3tn on Sept 2-4, close to but not above the Aug 25 series high of 18.8tn; the 13.3 and 14.3tn on Aug 30-31 and 15.3tn on Sept 5 are the usual weekend pattern. GPT-6 Astra's Sept 3 limited preview has not yet reached the API at scale, so its inference load shows up next week at the earliest. In a week of insider selling, a priced Fed hike and wider hyperscaler bond spreads, underlying inference demand stepped up again — still the hardest contrary evidence on the board.

indicators.value_display: 分化：主力上行·尾部塌陷
indicators.threshold_text: 环比 -15%+ 或普遍过剩 红 / 温和阴跌 黄 / 稳定或紧俏 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Down 15%+ or broad oversupply red / mild drift lower yellow / stable or tight green
indicators.note: 本期实抓价点（Thunder Compute 9/6 / getdeploying / Spheron）：H100 同业中位数 $3.32/GPU-hr，Thunder Compute 记其 90 日 +11%、同比 +11%，是长期阴跌后首次持续回升；同一提供商对比——Vast.ai 最低在库 $1.73（上期 $1.49，+16%）、Vast.ai H100 NVL $2.53、RunPod Secure Cloud $2.89-2.99、Nebius $3.85、CoreWeave $6.16（8 卡整机口径）、AWS p5 $6.88、Azure $12.29；H200 GMI $2.60 / Lambda $4.49 / CoreWeave $6.31；B200 中位数 $6.13、90 日持平、同比 +10%。反向侧两个新信号：① 市场化 spot 底价由 $0.61 再塌至 $0.35/hr（Vast.ai 竞价，同集合可比）；② 卖方叙事首次明确写出 H100 一代「正在浮现过剩」、而 H200 仍缺货（Nvidia 约 200 万颗订单 vs 约 70 万颗可供）。判定：主力合约与在库价没有 >15% 普遍下跌、中位数反而上行，维持绿；但「主力上行 + 尾部塌陷」是上一代算力开始被弃置的形态，若 H100 中位数下期转跌，本格转黄将是极重的信号。
indicators.note_en: Prices captured this week (Thunder Compute Sept 6, getdeploying, Spheron): the H100 cohort median is $3.32 per GPU-hour, which Thunder Compute records as up 11% over ninety days and 11% year on year — the first sustained rise after a long decline. Like-for-like by provider: Vast.ai's cheapest in-stock unit is $1.73 against $1.49 last week (up 16%), Vast.ai H100 NVL $2.53, RunPod Secure Cloud $2.89-2.99, Nebius $3.85, CoreWeave $6.16 on an eight-GPU node basis, AWS p5 $6.88 and Azure $12.29. H200 runs $2.60 at GMI, $4.49 at Lambda, $6.31 at CoreWeave; the B200 median is $6.13, flat over ninety days and 10% above a year ago. Two new signals on the other side: the marketplace spot floor fell again from $0.61 to $0.35 an hour (Vast.ai bidding, same set as last week), and sell-side commentary for the first time describes emerging oversupply in the H100 generation while H200 remains short, with about two million on order against roughly 700,000 available. Verdict: no broad decline near 15% in core contract or in-stock prices and a rising median, so green holds — but a rising core with a collapsing tail is what it looks like when a prior generation starts being abandoned. If the H100 median turns down next week, a move to yellow here would carry heavy weight.

indicators.threshold_text: 减速 红 / 平稳 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decelerating red / flat yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，本期复核（TechCrunch / CNBC / Bloomberg 8/13-8/17 三源）确认无任何晚于 8 月中旬的新披露。台账数字：Anthropic 7 月底年化 run rate 约 $650 亿（4 月 $300 亿 → 5 月底 $470 亿 → 7 月底 $650 亿，两个月月均 +$90 亿、此前 +$170 亿，二阶导为负）；OpenAI 约 $400 亿、月约 $33 亿，7 月环比 +20%（再加速），另有企业线 QTD +50%、广告 $10 亿 run rate。一加一减对冲，方向不明。**suspect_static 续标、计数升至 5**：OpenAI $400 亿连续 5 期、Anthropic $650 亿连续 3 期逐位未更新。唯一的旁证是 Salesforce 8/26 财报因 Anthropic 持股录得 $26 亿收益并推出「Claudeforce」——是估值而非收入。Anthropic 公开 S-1 是本格唯一能一次性替换全部二手估算的事件，投行讨论的 2028 年 $1900-2000 亿营收目标意味着招股书里会有可算二阶导的多年序列。
indicators.note_en: Yellow holds; this week's recheck across TechCrunch, CNBC and Bloomberg confirms nothing newer than the mid-August disclosures. The ledger stands at roughly $65bn annualised for Anthropic at end-July (from $30bn in April and $47bn in late May, so $9bn a month over the latest stretch against $17bn before — a negative second derivative) and about $40bn for OpenAI, roughly $3.3bn a month with July up 20% month on month, enterprise up 50% quarter to date and an ads line at a $1bn run rate. One accelerating, one decelerating, direction unresolved. The suspect-static flag stays on and the count rises to five: OpenAI's $40bn has not changed in five periods and Anthropic's $65bn in three. The only adjacent data point is Salesforce booking a $2.6bn gain on its Anthropic stake at its Aug 26 results and launching 'Claudeforce' — a valuation mark, not revenue. A public Anthropic S-1 remains the one event that replaces every second-hand estimate at once, and bankers' talk of $190-200bn of 2028 revenue implies the prospectus will carry a multi-year series from which a real second derivative can be computed.

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: 总体生产化读数沿用 McKinsey Q1 2026 的 72%，维持绿灯。本期新增的是 McKinsey 8/25 发布、9/6 仍在被二次报道的《State of AI 2026》年度调查（5/4-6/8 调研）：88-89% 的组织至少在一个职能使用 AI、企业级规模化比例由 38% 升至 44%、三个以上职能使用由 51% 升至 56%、$10 亿营收以上企业中 40% 已规模化 agent（上一轮 27%）——但报告 EBIT 正贡献的仍只有 37%、与去年持平。口径与本指标的「生产环境部署率」不同，不作为新读数替换 72%，但它把上期的结构性判断量化了：装上的多、用起来的在增、赚到钱的没动。Gartner / IDC / Deloitte 本窗口无新调查。下一次真实读点为 Q3 季度调查。
indicators.note_en: The headline production-deployment reading carries McKinsey's 72% from Q1 2026 and stays green. New this week is McKinsey's annual State of AI 2026 survey, published Aug 25 and still being syndicated on Sept 6 (fielded May 4 to June 8): 88-89% of organisations use AI in at least one function, enterprise-wide scaling rose from 38% to 44%, use across three or more functions from 51% to 56%, and 40% of firms above $1bn revenue now report scaled agents against 27% in the prior wave — yet only 37% report a positive EBIT contribution, unchanged from last year. The framing differs from this indicator's production-deployment rate, so it does not replace the 72%, but it quantifies last week's structural point: installed is high, in use is rising, paying off has not moved. No new Gartner, IDC or Deloitte survey in the window. Next real read: the Q3 quarterly survey.

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Shrinking red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 季度指标，三大云的 Q2 数字不变：MSFT 商业 RPO $6780 亿（+84%）、AWS $4960 亿、Google 积压 $5140 亿、Oracle RPO $6380 亿（Q4 FY26，+363%），大四合计约 $2.3 万亿。本期新增两个同向读点：Salesforce 8/26 财报 cRPO $335 亿（+14% 固定汇率），CoreWeave Q2 积压 $1042 亿（+246%）外加 $250 亿尚未入积压的新订单。**下一个真实读点已排定：Oracle 9/10 盘后发布 FQ1 FY27**——它是全部云厂商中积压对 OpenAI 集中度最高的一家，其 RPO 是否续增、以及 CDS 逾 200bp 之下的融资安排，是下期本格与 neocloud_credit、ai_ipo_pipeline 三格共同的交易对手风险检验。绿灯不变。
indicators.note_en: A quarterly series with the Q2 figures unchanged: Microsoft's commercial RPO at $678bn (up 84%), AWS $496bn, Google's backlog $514bn and Oracle's RPO $638bn (fiscal Q4, up 363%), roughly $2.3trn across the four. Two corroborating prints arrived this week: Salesforce's Aug 26 results showed current RPO of $33.5bn, up 14% in constant currency, and CoreWeave's Q2 backlog stands at $104.2bn, up 246%, with a further $25bn of new orders not yet booked. The next real read is scheduled: Oracle reports fiscal Q1 2027 after the close on Sept 10. It has the most OpenAI-concentrated backlog of any cloud, so whether its RPO keeps growing, and how it funds delivery with CDS above 200bp, is next week's joint counterparty test for this line, neocloud credit and the IPO pipeline. Green holds.

indicators.value_display: 加速·GPT-6 Astra 代际跳升
indicators.threshold_text: 连续两季无实质提升 红 / 放缓 黄 / 90 天内 SOTA 相对 +10% 或 METR 倍增 ≤7 月 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Two quarters flat red / slowing yellow / SOTA up 10%+ in 90 days or METR doubling under 7 months green
indicators.note: 上期预警的「HLE 第三期同值即触发复核」本期被一次代际发布直接化解。**佐证层**：OpenAI 9/3 限量预览 GPT-6 Astra（数日内推向付费层 / API / AWS），Brockman 称之为「代际跃迁」；8 月中旬还有 Grok 4.6、Gemini 3.7 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Muse Glimmer 同周发布，Q3 为年内最密集发布窗口。**辅锚**（BenchLM 9/3-9/4）：ARC-AGI-3 SOTA 由台账上期的 7.8%（GPT-5.6 Sol）跳至 62.7%（GPT-6 Astra；Claude Opus 5 为 30.2%）；FrontierMath v2 Tier 4 由 35.4% 跳至 97.6%（GPT-6 Astra，需留意 Epoch 6/12 曾修订 42% 的题目）；HLE BenchLM 榜首 65.0%（Claude Fable 5.1，上期 64.7%）、Artificial Analysis 口径 59.1%；SWE-bench Pro 81.2%（Claude Fable 5.1，上期 80.3%）。ARC-AGI-3 与 FrontierMath 的 90 日相对位移远超 +10% 绿灯门槛。**主锚**：metr.org 本期 egress 受限，官方倍增时间沿用台账 196 天（约 6.4 月）；搜索摘要另出现「TH 1.1 口径 131 天」的读数，与台账不一致、待下期直读核对，本期不改。叙事侧的「模型即商品、护城河在工作流」说法在扩散，但本周的证据是能力再跳升而非转向效率。绿。
indicators.note_en: Last week's warning that a third flat HLE reading would force a review was overtaken by a generational release. Corroboration layer: OpenAI opened a limited preview of GPT-6 Astra on Sept 3, rolling to paid tiers, the API and AWS within days, with Greg Brockman calling it a generational leap; mid-August also brought Grok 4.6, Gemini 3.7 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro and Muse Glimmer in a single week, making Q3 the densest release window of the year. Secondary anchor (BenchLM, Sept 3-4): the ARC-AGI-3 state of the art jumped from the ledger's 7.8% (GPT-5.6 Sol) to 62.7% (GPT-6 Astra, with Claude Opus 5 at 30.2%); FrontierMath v2 Tier 4 from 35.4% to 97.6% (GPT-6 Astra — note Epoch revised 42% of problems on June 12); HLE tops at 65.0% on BenchLM (Claude Fable 5.1, against 64.7%) and 59.1% on the Artificial Analysis protocol; SWE-bench Pro at 81.2% (Claude Fable 5.1, from 80.3%). The ninety-day relative moves on ARC-AGI-3 and FrontierMath clear the 10% green threshold many times over. Primary anchor: metr.org was blocked this run, so the official doubling time carries at 196 days, about 6.4 months; a search snippet citing 131 days under the Time Horizon 1.1 method conflicts with the ledger and is held for direct verification next week. The 'models are a commodity, the moat is the workflow' narrative is spreading, but this week's evidence is another capability jump, not a pivot to efficiency. Green.

indicators.name_zh: 会计造假/循环交易事件
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认 红 / 调查中 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed red / under investigation yellow / none green
indicators.note: 本期逐家复核 Nvidia / CoreWeave / Oracle / OpenAI / Palantir / Super Micro / Broadcom / AMD / Nebius / Applied Digital：窗口内无任何新的 SEC/DOJ 立案、审计师辞任或持续经营保留意见，维持绿灯。仍停留在第三方层面的三条：① Cape Fear Advisors 对 CoreWeave $13 亿递延收入重分类的质疑继续流传，CoreWeave Q2 递延收入升至 $97 亿、RPO $1037 亿，公司未回应；② Michael Burry 9 月初再度点名 Palantir 应收账款趋势；③ BofA 等测算 Oracle 积压中 OpenAI 占比逾 50%、质疑 RPO 转化节奏。Super Micro 的 DOJ/SEC 传票与独立调查属 2-3 月旧案、无新进展；本期搜到的审计师辞任（ScanTech AI、GenAI 等）均为无关小盘股。工具箱已就位（SEC 8/5 新设会计执法单元）、案子仍未来——这一格仍是全部绿灯里最脆的。
indicators.note_en: A name-by-name recheck of Nvidia, CoreWeave, Oracle, OpenAI, Palantir, Super Micro, Broadcom, AMD, Nebius and Applied Digital found no new SEC or DOJ action, auditor resignation or going-concern qualification in the window, so green holds. Three items remain at the third-party level: Cape Fear Advisors' challenge to CoreWeave's $1.3bn deferred-revenue reclassification is still circulating, with CoreWeave's Q2 deferred revenue up to $9.7bn and RPO at $103.7bn and no company response; Michael Burry renewed his criticism of Palantir's receivables trend in early September; and Bank of America and others estimate OpenAI at more than half of Oracle's backlog and question its conversion timing. Super Micro's DOJ and SEC subpoenas and independent investigation date from February and March with no new development, and the auditor resignations that surfaced (ScanTech AI, GenAI and others) are unrelated small caps. The enforcement toolkit is in place — the SEC's accounting unit stood up on Aug 5 — and the case has still not arrived. This remains the most brittle green on the board.
indicators.source_name: Cape Fear Advisors / 24/7 Wall St / SEC

indicators.threshold_text: 隐含加息 红 / 维持高利率 黄 / 隐含降息 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike priced red / high-for-long yellow / cut priced green
indicators.note: 维持红灯，且本期的红灯经受了一次完整的来回考验。CME 隐含 9/16 加息概率：8/31-9/1 一度升破 66%；9/3 理事 Waller 表态若通胀继续回落将支持按兵不动（「等一次会议的成本是什么？」，但明言若通胀数据偏热会考虑加息），概率回落至约 48-50%；9/4 非农 +16.2 万（预期约 5.6 万，6-7 月合计上修 5.5 万，失业率 4.1%，时薪同比 3.1%）后反弹至 59-62%（Kalshi 9/5 约 59% 加息 / 42% 维持）。模态结果连续第 2 期为「加息」，目标区间 3.50-3.75% → 3.75-4.00%。收益率：2 年期 9/4 约 4.37%（与 8/28 的 4.356% 基本持平）、10 年期升至约 4.76-4.78%（8/28 为 4.726%），长端继续抬升。8 月 CPI 定于 9/11 发布、距 FOMC 仅 5 天，是 Waller 明确的条件项——下期读数很可能是加息前的最后一次。信用面（HY OAS 265bps）与股市（标普 +0.1%）对此几乎无反应，是本期最值得记的裂口。
indicators.note_en: Red holds, and this week the call survived a full round trip. CME-implied odds of a Sept 16 hike rose above 66% on Aug 31 to Sept 1, then fell to about 48-50% on Sept 3 when Governor Waller said he would support holding if disinflation continues ('what's the cost of waiting one meeting?') while adding he would consider a hike if inflation came in hot, and rebounded to 59-62% after Sept 4's payrolls print of +162,000 against roughly 56,000 expected, with June and July revised up a combined 55,000, unemployment at 4.1% and hourly earnings up 3.1% year on year (Kalshi on Sept 5: about 59% hike, 42% hold). The modal outcome is a hike for a second consecutive period, taking the range from 3.50-3.75% to 3.75-4.00%. Yields: the two-year closed Sept 4 near 4.37%, essentially flat on Aug 28's 4.356%, while the ten-year rose to about 4.76-4.78% from 4.726%, so the long end keeps climbing. August CPI lands on Sept 11, five days before the meeting, and is Waller's explicit condition — next week's reading is likely the last before the decision. Credit (HY OAS at 265bp) and equities (S&P up 0.1%) have barely reacted, which is the most notable gap of the week.

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚 红 / 偶发惩罚 黄 / 奖励 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment red / episodic yellow / rewarded green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，本期有三个新的真实读点、方向仍然分裂。惩罚侧：Broadcom 9/2 财报把 FY26 AI 营收指引上调至 $580 亿并给出 FY27 $1150 亿 / FY28 $2300 亿的路径、同时宣布扩产把光学器件产能翻三倍，但 Q4 营收指引 $348 亿略低于一致预期 $350.3 亿，股价次日开盘 -5.76%——市场对「更大的多年 AI 路径」没有给分，却对单季指引的 0.6% 缺口重罚。奖励侧：Dell 9/1 凭 $950 亿 AI 服务器积压把 FY27 营收指引由 $1670 亿上调至约 $1920 亿，股价 +15.8%；Salesforce 8/27 因 Anthropic 合作与 $26 亿持股收益 +23%（AI 产品而非 capex 驱动）。反应函数的分裂线本期又挪了一次：上期是「现金流支出被奖励、债务敞口被惩罚」，本期是「AI 需求信号被奖励、季度指引精度被惩罚」——投资者在多年叙事之上开始逐季验收。既非系统性惩罚也非普遍奖励，黄。下一读点：Oracle 9/10。
indicators.note_en: Yellow holds on three new real tests that again split. On the punishment side, Broadcom's Sept 2 results raised the FY26 AI revenue guide to $58bn, laid out $115bn for FY27 and $230bn for FY28 and announced a tripling of optical-component capacity, yet Q4 revenue guidance of $34.8bn came in a hair under the $35.03bn consensus and the stock opened down 5.76% the next day — the market gave no credit for the larger multi-year path and punished a 0.6% shortfall on a single quarter. On the reward side, Dell lifted its FY27 revenue guide from $167bn to about $192bn on Sept 1 on a $95bn AI server backlog and rose 15.8%, while Salesforce jumped 23% on Aug 27 on its Anthropic tie-up and a $2.6bn gain on its stake, an AI-product rather than capex story. The fault line moved again: last week it was cash-funded spending rewarded and debt-funded exposure punished; this week it is AI demand signals rewarded and quarterly guidance precision punished — investors are auditing the multi-year narrative one quarter at a time. Neither systematic punishment nor blanket reward, so yellow. Next read: Oracle on Sept 10.

indicators.value_display_en: Rising, neoclouds named for the first time
indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热 红 / 部分对冲 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Broad admission red / partial hedging yellow / none green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，但承认侧本期出现了迄今最具体的一句。Altman 9/1 在 Alex Heath「Sources」播客首集说，他看到了「第一批感觉像不可持续的愚蠢的迹象——随机冒出的新 neocloud，声称明年要建巨量算力，而我认为他们没有支撑这些算力的收入」，同时补一句「我不担心我们自己的算力规划，我担心的是全世界的」。这比上期「投资者过度兴奋、还没到 iPhone 时刻」进了一档：第一次把「泡沫」落到一个具体的资产类别（neocloud），并把自己摘出来。反向侧不变且更硬：黄仁勋 9/4 续称需求受供给约束、对晶圆/内存/光学/电力有可见度，Broadcom 的 Hock Tan 在财报会上只有「需求火热、才刚开始」。Dimon / Pichai / Nadella / Zuckerberg / Jassy / Amodei / Ellison 窗口内无新表态。关键判据不变：无一家在承认过热的同时收缩支出——Broadcom 反而宣布扩产三倍。言行分离维持黄；转红需要「嘴上谨慎兑现成指引收缩」，或多位 CEO 同期跟进 Altman 的具名口径。
indicators.note_en: Yellow holds, but the admission side produced its most specific line yet. On Sept 1, on the debut episode of Alex Heath's 'Sources' podcast, Sam Altman said he sees 'the first signs of what feels to me like unsustainable silliness — random new neoclouds popping up, people claiming they're going to build gigantic amounts of compute next year that I think they don't have the revenue' to support, adding that he is not worried about OpenAI's own buildout but about the world's. That is a step beyond last week's 'investors overexcited, no iPhone moment yet': for the first time the word bubble is attached to a specific asset class, the neoclouds, with OpenAI carved out. The other side is unchanged and firmer: Jensen Huang on Sept 4 again described demand as supply-constrained with visibility into wafers, memory, optics and power, and Broadcom's Hock Tan offered nothing but 'demand was simply hot and we're just getting started.' No new statements from Dimon, Pichai, Nadella, Zuckerberg, Jassy, Amodei or Ellison in the window. The decisive test stands: not one company is pairing an admission of overheating with reduced spending — Broadcom instead announced a tripling of capacity. Words and actions remain apart, so yellow. Red needs verbal caution converted into guidance, or several chief executives echoing Altman's named target in the same period.
